_about: Azulejo design tokens. Single source for colours, radii, spacing, type, status icons, symbol sizes and motion. The macOS shell reads them through apps/macos/Sources/Azulejo/Design.swift, generated by scripts/design-tokens; the Linux shell (M3) reads this file too. Colours come from docs/design/mockup-v1.png (One Dark); radii and spacing are the values shipping today, and docs/design/README.md lists the mockup targets that D.5 moves them to. Light colours are provisional. Hex colours are #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa. Keys starting with an underscore are notes.

color._note: Each colour has a dark and a light value; the shell picks one from the window's appearance.

window._use: window background, gutters between tiles, toolbar row

sidebar._use: sidebar card, tab bar, tile header strip

tile._use: tile body: terminal backdrop, browser, preview, files

sunken._use: browser chrome, code blocks, inset strips

control._use: segmented tracks, search field, tab container

selected._use: selected sidebar row, selected palette row

border._use: hairlines around cards, fields and toasts

textSecondary._use: tab labels, details, tile header icons

textMuted._use: group labels, branches, subtitles, hidden files

textOnAccent._use: text on HUDs, badges and coloured fills

dimFill._use: what unfocused tiles fade towards (alpha.unfocusedDim): the window colour, so they recede into the gutters. Ghostty's unfocused-split-fill overrides it

hud._use: status HUD in the window corner

ghostFill._use: tile outlines during the outline animation style

header._use: tile header strip (mockup: the focused claude tile; unfocused strips get there through the dim, #202329)

headerHairline._use: line under a tile's header strip

browserChrome._use: browser tile toolbar (back, forward, address, reload)

kindTerminal._use: placeholder tile bodies before a tile kind's view exists

tabStrip._use: the tab strip's pill container in the toolbar

searchBorderActive._use: search field hairline while quick open is open

titlebarIcon._use: sidebar toggle next to the traffic lights

radius._note: Tile values follow the mockup (D.5); sidebar card target 12 (D.3). focus: a border drawn just outside a tile (the attention border). tabStrip/tab/search*: the toolbar (D.2/D.4/D.8, from the mockup). badgeDot/machineDot: the agent badge's state dot and a machine's connection dot (round, so each is half the dot's width).

border._note: attention: tiles whose agent needs a look. Focus has no border: unfocused tiles dim instead (alpha.unfocusedDim).

alpha._note: Opacities (0 to 1) applied on top of colour tokens, so no view carries its own. bannerMix is how much window colour the config banner's tinted fill is blended with. unfocusedDim is the focus indicator: every unfocused tile (header strip included) gets color.dimFill over it at this opacity, which turns the mockup's focused colours into its unfocused ones (body #282c34 → #252830, mockup #252930; header #21252b → #202329, as sampled). Ghostty's unfocused-split-opacity overrides it (dim = 1 − opacity; Ghostty's own default is 0.3).

space._note: Points. gutter is the space between tiles (D.5). tileInset is 0: the window layout (windowInset, D.2) owns the margin round the tile area. tileContentPad is the margin round a terminal's text; browserChromeHeight is the browser toolbar, which replaces the header strip on browser tiles. Sidebar width target 230 (D.3). toolbar*/titlebar*/tab*/search*/windowInset: window chrome from the mockup (D.2/D.4/D.8); titlebarLights* is the close button's top-left from the window's top-left, titlebarZone the sidebar card's band for the traffic lights.
space._tabOverflow: Provisional, pending the designer: with more tabs than fit, tabs shrink to tabFitMinWidth and no further; the strip then scrolls sideways, with tabFadeWidth fades at the edges that have more tabs.
space._sidebar: Inside the sidebar card (D.3): the side padding of its rows, a workspace row's height, the Agents | Files control (sidebarSegmentTop below the card's top band, as in the mockup), the gap above the list, a machine group's label row and its + row, and the footer. The card, its inset and its top band are the window chrome's (D.2).
space._rail: The collapsed sidebar (a rail): its card's width, the side padding of its rows, a machine group's letter row, a workspace or agent row, the gap before the agents, and the expand control at the bottom.
space._header: Tile header strip: headerTitleMin is the least room the title keeps; when the tile's controls (Preview | Source, the files buttons) would leave less, they hide whole rather than clip. badgeInset is the agent badge's gap from the strip's right edge.
space._findBar: The find bar (⌘F): findFieldMin is the least room the query keeps; below it the bar's controls hide whole, the count first, then previous / next, then close (their keys still work).
space._browserBanner: The browser's notice strip: below browserBannerButtonMin points wide its button hides, so the message stays readable (⌘R still retries).

font._note: UI fonts are the system font; terminals use the user's Ghostty font. weight: light | regular | medium | semibold | bold. mono: true uses the monospaced system font.

status._note: Agent and machine states: SF Symbol plus colour token. Used by the sidebar, tabs, footer and badges. Symbols named azulejo.* are drawn by the app: azulejo.ring is the mockup's partial ring for working, rotating while motion is on.

icon._note: SF Symbols for tile kinds and palette row kinds.

symbol._note: SF Symbol point sizes, by where the symbol sits.

motion._note: Milliseconds. Reference values; the [animation] config section owns the live ones (its curve, and on/off). focus is the unfocused-tile dim's cross-fade when focus moves, a fixed length whatever duration_ms says.
